process HAPPY_REPORT {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_single'

    // WARN: Version information not provided by tool on CLI. Please update version string below when bumping container versions.
    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/6e/6e1aa20442ec807e9aa59cc5b46811e6758667c295610a745c5ab9cdb23c4e0d/data':
        'community.wave.seqera.io/library/pip_ga4gh-happy-report:72e6bf058d448a4c' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), val(csv_meta), path(csv, arity: '1..*')

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.html"), emit: html
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('ga4gh-happy-report'), val('0.1.2'), topic: versions, emit: versions_happy

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def csv_list = csv instanceof List ? csv : [csv]
    def csv_meta_list = csv_meta instanceof List ? csv_meta : [csv_meta]
    assert csv_meta_list.size() == csv_list.size() : "HAPPY_REPORT: 'csv_meta' and 'csv' must be the same length (got ${csv_meta_list.size()} csv_meta entries, ${csv_list.size()} files)"
    def labelled_csv = [csv_meta_list, csv_list]
        .transpose()
        .collect { m, file -> m.comparison_method ? "${m.method}_${m.comparison_method}:${file}" : "${m.method}:${file}" }
        .join(' ')
    """
    rep.py \\
        $args \\
        $labelled_csv \\
        -o ${prefix}.html
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.html
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/happy/report"
description: "Generate standalone HTML benchmarking reports from GA4GH / hap.py variant-calling\
  \ metrics CSVs"
keywords:
- "happy"
- "benchmark"
- "report"
- "html"
- "variant-calling"
tools:
- happy:
    description: "Generate standalone HTML benchmarking reports from GA4GH / hap.py\
      \ variant-calling metrics CSVs"
    homepage: "https://github.com/bag-cnag/ga4gh-happy-report"
    documentation: "https://github.com/bag-cnag/ga4gh-happy-report"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/bag-cnag/ga4gh-happy-report"
    licence:
    - "Apache-2.0"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - csv_meta:
      type: "list"
      description: "A list of maps, one per entry in `csv`, in the same order. Each\
        \ map\nmust contain a `method` string key (e.g. the variant caller name,\n\
        such as `gatk4` or `deepvariant`) and may contain a\n`comparison_method` string\
        \ key (e.g. `vcfeval` or `happy`). Together\nthey build the GA4GH `<method>_<comparisonmethod>:<file>`\
        \ label used\nto identify each file's results in the report, e.g.\n`[ method:'gatk4',\
        \ comparison_method:'vcfeval' ]`. Omit\n`comparison_method` to use just `<method>:<file>`\
        \ for that file.\n"
  - csv:
      type: "file"
      description: "One or more GA4GH metrics ROC CSV files (e.g. the `*.roc.all.csv.gz`\
        \ output of hap.py/som.py), one report entry per file. Gzip-compressed files\
        \ are read transparently. Each file is labelled using the corresponding entry\
        \ in `csv_meta`."
      pattern: "*.{csv,csv.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
output:
  html:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.html':
        type: "file"
        description: "Standalone HTML benchmarking report"
        pattern: "*.html"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2331"
  versions_happy:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - ga4gh-happy-report:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - "0.1.2":
        type: "string"
        description: "The version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - ga4gh-happy-report:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - "0.1.2":
        type: "string"
        description: "The version of the tool"
